verdict.rationale: Typesense has API reference pages, but the pack shows nothing interactive: they offer a "Copy Markdown" button and a version switcher, with no try-it console, sandbox or runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, so there is no evidence of a spec-driven interactive explorer. API reference tooling is a fair axis for a search engine with a REST API, so this is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
